title: pellegrinia rimbachii
intro: Pellegrinia rimbachii, commonly known as the "Andaman oak", is a species of tree native to the Andaman Islands in India. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions. The plant is known to exhibit health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Pellegrinia rimbachii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
